clips.title: The story
paras: At Gol'Bolar Quarry, Senator Mehr Stonehallow faces a trogg infestation. The Ironforge politician and Explorers' League member has come to the front lines to oversee its containment, enlisting eager adventurers to cull the beasts before they overrun the quarry.

Senator Mehr Stonehallow has left Ironforge's Senate halls for Gol'Bolar Quarry. A dwarf devoted to governance and the Explorers' League's historical pursuits, he knows the dangers facing the realm. When Rockjaw troggs clawed their way from the deep rock, Stonehallow traveled to the mining pit himself. He believes debate alone will not protect the workers, so he offers bounties to capable travelers who can drive back the aggressive troggs and reclaim the quarry.
